t: A pocket groovebox and synth with open firmware you can rewrite.
steps: Buy a PGB-1 from Crowd Supply, Lectronz, or the Wee Noise Makers shop.
Read the PGB-1 user manual on the Wee Noise Makers GitHub page.
Turn it on and tap a drum pattern into the sequencer.
Add a synth track and play a melody on the keys.
Record a sound with the microphone and use it in the sampler.
Try the Ada SDK, Rust crate, or CircuitPython for your own firmware.
meta: Open Board. From $275. A few stores.
